We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product. Multiplying the first row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-6 & 4 \\ 8 & -5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}(-6)\cdot 2+4\cdot 4 \\ ∗\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ ∗\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the second row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-6 & 4 \\ 8 & -5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 8\cdot 2+(-5)\cdot 4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$Ax=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -4\end{aligned}].$
